date_label: M. 1874; ended by his death, 24 October 1910
summary: Mabel Hatch, born in Calcutta, married George Batten in 1874 at about eighteen, and took the name under which she appears everywhere afterwards. He was secretary to the Viceroy of India; they had a daughter, Cara. The marriage lasted thirty-six years and outlived the beginning of her attachment to Radclyffe Hall by three - she met Hall in 1907 and moved in with her only once widowed.

sources.quote: In 1874, she married George Batten, secretary to the Viceroy of India. They had one daughter, the painter and film maker Lady Cara Harris.
sources.context: Wikipedia, 'Mabel Batten', 'Personal life'. The marriage sentence carries a footnote to Emily Hamer, Britannia's Glory (Bloomsbury, 2016 edn), p. 94.
sources.supports: The marriage, its year, the husband's post and the daughter.
